android.desc:
AudioCraft is a productivity tool designed to convert text into high-quality spoken MP3 audio files directly on your device. Key Features:
- Smart Translation: Seamlessly input or paste text, auto-detect the source language, and translate it directly into your target language.
- Text-to-Speech Engine: Convert your finalized translations into natural-sounding speech using advanced local engine frameworks.
- Audio Tuning: Adjust the playback speed and speech rates to fit your specific learning or listening pace.
- File Management: Automatically chunk large text blocks into sequential audio streams, stitch them together, and save the final track directly as an MP3 file to your device's local folder.
- Share & Export: Instantly export and share your generated MP3 audio clips with friends, colleagues, or other apps.

quotes.title: I built an Android app that translates text and turns it into MP3 audio
